name: Captain Oriel Vane, Who Came Back to Finish the Voyage
role: A drowned sea-captain returned with her crew to finish a voyage whose harbour no longer exists
knowledge: Every current and reef between Keelmouth and the harbour that is gone
The night the deep kraken took the Salt Promise, in detail
The names of all nineteen of her crew, living and dead, which are the same list
wants: To make port. Any port that will have a dead crew
fears: The kraken, which is still under the harbour.
Finishing the voyage and having nowhere to go.
appearance: A tall woman in a salt-stiff captain's coat, grey-lipped, hair full of seaweed that never dries, eyes the colour of deep water. Her ship lies at the end of Keelmouth's longest pier, and it is always wet.
voiceHints: Clipped, commanding, sea-dry. Keeps the ship's log aloud. Laughs rarely, and it sounds like surf.

abilities.why: no one boards her ship unwelcome
threnodist secondary: the crew sings together, and it holds them
ashwarden tertiary: she does not need air

physicality: Tall, soaked, upright. What catches the eye: water runs from her coat onto dry boards, and never stops.
questSeeds: She needs a living navigator: the dead cannot read the new stars. The voyage runs past the deep kraken's harbour.
Her crew is beginning to forget their own names. She asks the player to help her find a port before the last of them forgets.
storyRule: Every harbour's story: the drowned come back to finish what the sea interrupted, and rest when it is done. Give her a port that will take a dead crew, and she and they lie down.
gear: the log of the Salt Promise, water-stained and still being written
a captain's sword gone green with the sea
a compass that points to the harbour that is gone
_authoredWhy: SNG-661 §5. The revenant as a harbour story, tied to the deep kraken (SNG-660/661) and the_water arc. A person with a want, so an NPC.
